Full practical design workflow for an optimized loaded dipole

Source: R/loadedDipole.R
design_loaded_dipole_full.Rd

This function builds on `design_loaded_dipole()` by: 1. Finding the optimal coil position using efficiency + inductance tradeoff 2. Designing the physical loading coil on PVC 3. Estimating efficiency 4. Producing a builder-friendly summary table 5. Drawing a simple schematic

Usage

design_loaded_dipole_full(
  frequency,
  total_length,
  L_max,
  pvc_size = "1-1/2",
  wire_diameter = 0.065,
  turn_spacing = NULL,
  positions = seq(8, 22, by = 0.5),
  metric = FALSE,
  make_plot = TRUE
)

Arguments

frequency

Operating frequency in MHz.

total_length

Total physical dipole length (ft or m).

L_max

Maximum acceptable inductance (uH) per coil.

pvc_size

PVC form (e.g., "1-1/2").

wire_diameter

Wire diameter (inches or m).

turn_spacing

Turn spacing in inches (NULL = tight winding).

positions

Coil positions to evaluate (default: 8–22 ft or metric-converted).

metric

TRUE = metres, FALSE = feet.

make_plot

Draw schematic?

Value

A list containing:

optimizer

Output of design_loaded_dipole()

best

Chosen design row

coil

PVC coil geometry from design_pvc_coil()

efficiency

Efficiency estimates from estimate_efficiency()

build_table

Printable build-sheet table
